Regression controls require the unchanged master semantics: a held current drain returns Ok(None) without external requests, and a saved begin without an active grant records uncertainty/rebind rather than an immediate checkpoint; a separate active-grant control requires its checkpoint.

The earlier in-scope Medium corrections remain present and reviewed on that same input: visible natural-waiter cleanup failure with retained exact ownership; ACP pending-call drain before EOF; bounded off-lock failed-launch ownership retention; atomic runtime assignment/owner registration; exact Confirmed revocation suppression; ordinary/root callback checkpoint and join ordering; retained Error after late quarantined failure; denied uncertain late-reader projection; and successful-result joining of an exact InProgress owner with locked owner/generation/Stop revalidation.

The judged source revision, named source root, launcher input fingerprint and gate run are explicitly associated; another item's passing check alone does not satisfy this binding.

The independent read-only Codex/Claude pair reviews every hunk of all 33 staged paths and affected production consumers on that same input, applies all six repository lenses, and has no outstanding in-scope Medium or higher finding.
